name: r2-silu-bw-c16coop-c1coop
author: solx-loop
description: The launch path on B200 can be tuned below the cluster-of-2 launch through launch attributes alone; the kernel body is unchanged. Grids of 64 CTAs or fewer (n <= 65536) launch as non-portable clusters of 16 with the cooperative attribute, which is 0.14-0.22 us faster than cluster-2. Grids of 65-1184 CTAs launch with cluster dimension 1 plus cooperative, which is 0.18-0.23 us faster at 160K-786K. Grids above 1184 CTAs keep the plain launch.
